errors.evidence: The color mapping is not fully correct as stated. In the figure, blue bars correspond to embedding and 1st layer; green bars correspond to the random-layer variants with pre-trained embeddings; red bars correspond to the random-model variants with random embeddings; and orange bars correspond to unperturbed trained models. However, the description incorrectly implies these colors differentiate all paired variants in every category, which is not how the bars are grouped.
